title: Stasis on the Bayou
description: A surreal bayou scene at dusk features a large gnarled tree with a vibrant rainbow spiral and Domino's pizza logo floating above. In the foreground, a skeleton in a red cap stands on the porch of a green wooden shack labeled 'STASIS', while an angel with rainbow wings hovers in the fiery sky and various figures wade in the purple waters below.
prompt: Surreal bayou scene at sunset with a massive ancient tree covered in moss. A glowing rainbow spiral swirls around the tree with a Domino's pizza logo floating above it. A blue angel with large rainbow wings stands on the roof of a weathered green wooden shack. A skeleton wearing a red baseball cap gestures from the shack's porch which has the word STASIS written on it. Strange figures wade in the purple swamp water near a red bridge, with a white bird and blue snake visible near the tree roots under a dramatic orange and purple sky.
